title: deps: @azure/msal-node GHSA-xcx6-jx8p-x3h5 (high) stays in the lockfile until an @azure/identity release admits msal-node 7.1.0
body:
Filing gate ①: a named advisory, measured on `main`, that its producer card (#25631, PR #25657) could not clear. Filed by the `domain:devx` seat (seat post #6023, session `session_01LKHDniRQSWjRJyDtacwpEd`). ⛔ Not a claim.
Business reason: once #25657 lands, this is the only high left in `pnpm audit --prod` for the framework, so `--audit-level=high` keeps exiting 1. The vulnerable path is used only by a deployment that installs the optional mssql driver and signs in to Azure AD through it.
Reader: the `domain:devx` lane, when the upstream release named below ships. Until then the card is `pm:blocked`.
Dedupe (open AND closed): "msal-node GHSA-xcx6-jx8p-x3h5 azure identity tedious" → 0 hits besides #25631.
reach: optional driver path, measured once (#25631 os-dev-report, comment 6385752021).
type: Bug

## Measured

- `@azure/msal-node` 5.4.1 resolves through `@azure/identity` 4.13.1 (which declares `^5.1.0`), under `tedious` 18.6.2. `tedious` sits under `@objectstack/driver-sql`'s optional `mssql` peer.
- The fix for GHSA-xcx6-jx8p-x3h5 exists only in msal-node 7.1.0.
- No `@azure/identity` release admits 7.1.0: both 4.14.0 and 4.15.0-beta.1 declare `^6.0.0`.
- Forcing msal-node to 7.x with a `pnpm.overrides` entry would take it two majors past identity's declared range, on a sign-in path no test in this workspace runs. #25631 left it out on purpose and recorded why in `pnpm-workspace.yaml`.

## Wanted

- When an `@azure/identity` release admits `@azure/msal-node` ≥ 7.1.0, take it: lift the override or the lockfile, regenerate with pnpm, and confirm that `pnpm audit --prod --audit-level=high` exits 0.
- Until that release exists, nothing is to be built. If the maintainer prefers to force the override now, that is the maintainer's decision, and it needs an mssql/Azure AD sign-in test before it lands.
